title: Calmer interface and sharper feedback
notes: Improved: The interface uses calmer surfaces, restrained color, subtler shadows, and cleaner navigation.
Improved: The Native Beta badge is removed from Today; version details remain in Settings and the Update log.
Improved: Navigation transitions are shorter and Reduce motion can remove them completely.
Improved: Haptics use short, sharp device-tuned clicks for taps, confirmations, completions, and warnings.
Privacy: Owner-only cloud rules are prepared and tested; sign-in, sync, and cloud photos remain unavailable in this build.
